e.title: AP7（瑞典保费养老金默认基金）：公开回报与年度报告
e.title_en: AP7 (Sweden’s default premium-pension fund): published returns and annual reports
e.title_hk: AP7（瑞典保費養老金默認基金）：公開回報與年度報告
e.summary: 瑞典保费养老金（premiepension）默认选项的公共基金管理人：发布年度财务报告与定期回报，实测 2026 上半年回报 17.9%
e.summary_en: The public fund managing the default option in Sweden’s premium pension: it publishes annual financial reports and periodic returns, with a measured 17.9% return for the first half of 2026
e.summary_hk: 瑞典保費養老金（premiepension）默認選項的公共基金管理人：發布年度財務報告與定期回報，實測 2026 上半年回報 17.9%
e.body:
**AP7** 是**瑞典保费养老金（premiepension）体系中「默认选项」的公共基金管理人**——瑞典参保人若不自选基金，缴费即进入 AP7 的默认组合（含**股票基金 AP7 Aktiefond** 与**固定收益/杠杆结构**）。本条目属本轮**填补北欧空白**，补的是**「公共默认基金」这一形态**：池内已有大量**资产管理工具与养老金机构**（[[dnb]]、[[pbgc]]、[[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]），但**「国家为默认选项设立的公共基金，其回报与年报公开可查」这一条此前没有**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **70.4KB**；⭐ **年度财务报告页 `/english/about-us/annual-financial-reports/`（58KB）** 实测存在；站点新闻实测可见 **「AP7:s avkastning 17,9 procent under första halvåret 2026」**（**2026 年上半年回报 17.9%**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「默认选项基金」这一形态**——**默认选项的设计（默认基金、生命周期调整、杠杆）本身就是养老金政策工具**，而 AP7 是**全球最受关注的公共默认基金之一**；对做**养老金投资与默认选项设计**的学生，其**公开回报与年报**是**可直接引用的实证材料**（与 [[pensionsmyndigheten]] 的统计、[[dnb]] 的覆盖率、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 的基金级数据形成**「管理机构 → 默认基金 → 覆盖率 → 基金级统计」**的链条）。**② 与「回报披露」这一主题相关**——公共基金的年度报告与定期回报是**养老金透明度的样板**，可与 [[pensions-authority-ie]]（登记披露）、[[hkmc]]（计划统计）并读。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页、年度财务报告页的存在与首页新闻中的回报数字**，**但未打开年报、未核实回报口径**（如是否含费用、是否杠杆后），**故词条只记录页面实测到的事实，不解释回报来源**；**② 站点以瑞典语为主**，英文页面（`/english/…`）**覆盖度未逐项核实**；**③** AP7 的投资策略（含杠杆与生命周期设计）**本次未核实其官方说明**，**不作描述**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供基金分析工具或投资建议。**核实说明**：首页（70.4KB）与年度财务报告页（58KB）HTTP 200 实测；**未打开年报、未核实回报口径**。
e.body_en:
**AP7** is **the public fund managing the default option in Sweden’s premium pension (premiepension)** — savers who do not choose a fund have their contributions directed into AP7’s default portfolio (including the **AP7 Aktiefond equity fund** and a fixed-income/leveraged structure). This entry belongs to this round’s **Nordic gap-filling**, adding the "**public default fund**" form: the corpus already holds many **asset-management tools and pension institutions** ([[dnb]], [[pbgc]], [[pensionsmyndigheten]], [[retirement-planning]], [[longevity-mortality-investor]]), but **"a public fund established as the state default option, with published returns and annual reports" had no entry**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage is **70.4KB**; ⭐ the **annual financial reports page `/english/about-us/annual-financial-reports/` (58KB)** was verified; a site news item shows **"AP7:s avkastning 17,9 procent under första halvåret 2026"** (**a 17.9% return in the first half of 2026**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "default-option fund" form** — **the design of the default option (default fund, lifecycle adjustment, leverage) is itself a pension policy instrument**, and AP7 is **one of the most watched public default funds worldwide**; for students working on **pension investment and default design**, its **published returns and annual reports are directly citable empirical material** (chaining with the statistics of [[pensionsmyndigheten]], the funding ratios of [[dnb]] and the fund-level data of [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] as an "**administrator → default fund → funding ratio → fund-level statistics**" sequence). **② It bears on return disclosure** — a public fund’s annual reports and periodic returns are a **template for pension transparency**, readable with the register disclosure of [[pensions-authority-ie]] and the scheme statistics of [[hkmc]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage, the existence of the annual financial reports page and the return figure appearing in homepage news**, **but opened no annual report and did not verify the return’s definition** (e.g. whether it is net of fees or levered), so **this entry records only what was measured and does not explain the source of the return**; **② the site is mainly Swedish**, and **English coverage (`/english/…`) was not verified item by item**; **③** AP7’s investment strategy (including leverage and lifecycle design) **was not verified against official documentation, so it is not described**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers fund-analysis tools or investment advice**. **Verification note**: the homepage (70.4KB) and the annual financial reports page (58KB) were measured at HTTP 200; **no annual report was opened and the return definition was not verified**.
e.body_hk:
**AP7** 是**瑞典保費養老金（premiepension）「默認選項」的公共基金管理人**。本條目屬本輪**填補北歐空白**，補的是**「公共默認基金」這一形態**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **70.4KB**；⭐ **年度財務報告頁（58KB）** 實測存在；站點新聞實測可見 **「AP7:s avkastning 17,9 procent under första halvåret 2026」**（**2026 上半年回報 17.9%**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「默認選項基金」這一形態**——**默認選項的設計（默認基金、生命週期調整、槓桿）本身就是養老金政策工具**，AP7 是**全球最受關注的公共默認基金之一**；其**公開回報與年報可直接引用**（與 [[pensionsmyndigheten]]、[[dnb]]、[[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 形成「**管理機構 → 默認基金 → 覆蓋率 → 基金級統計**」鏈條）；**② 與回報披露主題相關**，可與 [[pensions-authority-ie]]、[[hkmc]] 並讀。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁、年報頁存在與首頁新聞中的回報數字**，**但未打開年報、未核實回報口徑**（是否含費用、是否槓桿後），**故只記錄實測事實**；**② 站點以瑞典語為主**；**③** AP7 的投資策略**未核實官方說明，不作描述**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供基金分析工具或投資建議。**核實說明**：兩頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開年報、未核實回報口徑**。
